Machine-readable package: Data tools can consume all four CSV resources, field schemas, byte counts, and SHA-256 hashes through the standards-based Data Package descriptor.
Relationship disclosure: Nizlo, a Windows-first RMM and IT-management platform, maintains these resources. The templates are designed for use with any RMM and do not claim that any vendor passes their controls.
